description:
Emma has been strengthened through the Tactical Upgrade plan.
Compared to before, her heart is broader and her abilities are further enhanced. However, her cooking skills have not improved one iota.

levels.name: Environment Setup
levels.description:
■ Activates at the start of battle. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Environment Setup

<word_group=10085>Recurring interval</word_group>: 30 sec</color>

■ Activates when the enemy appears. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Exposure (Cannot be removed)
Effect: Attract: Taunts all enemies continuously.</color>

costumes.name: Secret Therapy
costumes.description:
Emma: Tactical Upgrade costume.
Obtained from a Mission Pass.

lines.text: If you're tired, drink this. It's a special remedy I whipped up to help with fatigue.
I made a new blend of perfume. What do you think, Commander?
If you need anything, just let me know, okay?
I was thinking of you when I crafted this fragrance, Commander. If you like it, I can make more for you.
This outfit contains a special solution. The texture is really something. Want to give it a feel?

You seem a bit worn out, Commander.
Here, lay your head on my lap. I've been studying a new kind of therapy.

Commander? Oh my, I guess you fell asleep...
Hehe. You must have been running yourself ragged lately.

You seem so busy lately...
I'll leave a scent diffuser in your room to help you sleep better.

Have you noticed how Eunhwa's expression softens a little whenever you visit the Armory?
Hehe. Don't tell her I said that.
Looks like everyone has their hands full. Should I prepare some finger food that's easy to munch on?

If you're bored, want to go shopping with me?
I just ran out of the ingredients I need to make perfume.

I'll be right by your side again, looking after you so you don't get worn out, Commander.
Hehehe. Take good care of me too, okay?
Now I can help you feel even more comfortable.
Hehe. I bet I can get even stronger than this.
I've got a better grasp of controlling the liquid solution now.
Hehe, thank you! I'll treasure it dearly.
You really are such a kind-hearted person, Commander.
I'd love to give you a therapy session in return—do you have a minute?
Anytime you want to relax, you can always come to me.

Have you ever felt that fluttery feeling in your chest, Commander?
Whenever I'm with you, I get that exact feeling.
Vesti, Eunhwa, and you are all precious to me, Commander. But with you, it feels a little more special somehow.
If you need cover fire during battle, leave it to me.
Mmhm. I'm listening.
Got it. Heading that way.
Enemy spotted. Should we engage?
Well then, shall we face it together?
I'll make sure they don't move an inch.
All right everyone, let's relax and get started.
Hang on just a sec.
Sorry, this is taking a while, isn't it?
I just need a short break to reload.
Liquid solution at the ready.
Here you go! A little therapy for everyone.
C'mon, everyone, let's all attack together!
That was great. Hehe.
It's done.
Nothing to worry about.
Ahh!
Oh my!
Eek!
I'm sorry, Commander, I might have overdone it...
You did great, Commander. Did you like the new scent?
